AudioMuxingToggle.help: When enabled, audio from the original video is preserved in the exported video. Disable to skip audio muxing if it causes the engine to hang.
AudioMuxingToggle.label: Enable Audio

AutoColorEnableToggle.help: Enable AutoColor Transfer: 1. Hans Test without mask, 2. Hans Test with mask, 3. DFL Method without mask, 4. DFL Original Method.
AutoColorEnableToggle.label: AutoColor Transfer

AutoColorTransferTypeSelection.help: Select the AutoColor transfer method type. Hans Method could have some artefacts sometimes.
AutoColorTransferTypeSelection.label: Transfer Type

AutoRotationToggle.help: Automatically rotate the input to detect faces in various orientations.
AutoRotationToggle.label: Auto Rotation

AutoSwapToggle.help: Automatically Swap all faces using selected Source Faces/Embeddings when loading an video/image file
AutoSwapToggle.label: Auto Swap

BackgroundBlurParserSlider.help: Blend the value for Background Parser
BackgroundBlurParserSlider.label: Background Blur

BackgroundParserSlider.help: Negative/Positive values shrink and grow the mask.
BackgroundParserSlider.label: Background

BorderBottomSlider.help: A rectangle with adjustable bottom, left, right, top, and sides that masks the swapped face result back into the original image.
BorderBottomSlider.label: Bottom Border

BorderLeftSlider.help: A rectangle with adjustable bottom, left, right, top, and sides that masks the swapped face result back into the original image.
BorderLeftSlider.label: Left Border

BorderRightSlider.help: A rectangle with adjustable bottom, left, right, top, and sides that masks the swapped face result back into the original image.
BorderRightSlider.label: Right Border

BorderTopSlider.help: A rectangle with adjustable bottom, left, right, top, and sides that masks the swapped face result back into the original image.
BorderTopSlider.label: Top Border

ClipEnableToggle.help: Use descriptions to identify objects that will be present in the final swapped image.
ClipEnableToggle.label: Text Masking

ClipText.help: To use, type a word(s) in the box separated by commas and press <enter>.
ClipText.label: Text Masking Entry

ColorEnableToggle.help: Fine-tune the RGB color values of the swap.
ColorEnableToggle.label: Color Adjustments

DFLXSegEnableToggle.help: Allow objects occluding the face to show up in the swapped image.
DFLXSegEnableToggle.label: DFL XSeg Mask

DFLXSegSizeSlider.help: Grows or shrinks the occluded region.
DFLXSegSizeSlider.label: Size

DFMAmpMorphSlider.help: AMP Morph Factor for DFM AMP Models
DFMAmpMorphSlider.label: AMP Morph Factor

DFMModelSelection.help: Select which pretrained DeepFaceLive (DFM) Model to use for swapping.
DFMModelSelection.label: DFM Model

DFMRCTColorToggle.help: RCT Color Transfer for DFM Models
DFMRCTColorToggle.label: RCT Color Transfer

DetectFromPointsToggle.help: Enable detection of faces from specified landmark points.
DetectFromPointsToggle.label: Detect From Points

DetectorModelSelection.help: Select the face detection model to use for detecting faces in the input image or video.
DetectorModelSelection.label: Face Detect Model

DetectorScoreSlider.help: Set the confidence score threshold for face detection. Higher values ensure more confident detections but may miss some faces.
DetectorScoreSlider.label: Detect Score

DifferencingAmountSlider.help: Higher values relaxes the similarity constraint.
DifferencingAmountSlider.label: Amount

DifferencingEnableToggle.help: Allow some of the original face to show in the swapped result when the difference between the two images is small. Can help bring back some texture to the swapped face.
DifferencingEnableToggle.label: Differencing

EmbMergeMethodSelection.help: Select the method to merge facial embeddings. "Mean" averages the embeddings, while "Median" selects the middle value, providing more robustness to outliers.
EmbMergeMethodSelection.label: Embedding Merge Method

EyeBrowsMakeupBlendAmountDecimalSlider.help: Blend the value: 0.00 represents the original color, 1.00 represents the full target color.
EyeBrowsMakeupBlendAmountDecimalSlider.label: Blend Amount

EyeGlassesParserSlider.help: Adjust the size of the Mask. Mast the eyeglasses.
EyeGlassesParserSlider.label: EyeGlasses

EyeLeftXAmountSlider.help: Shifts the eye left detection point left and right.
EyeLeftXAmountSlider.label: Left Eye:   X

EyeLeftYAmountSlider.help: Shifts the eye left detection point up and down.
EyeLeftYAmountSlider.label: Left Eye:   Y

EyeRightXAmountSlider.help: Shifts the eye right detection point left and right.
EyeRightXAmountSlider.label: Right Eye:   X

EyeRightYAmountSlider.help: Shifts the eye right detection point up and down.
EyeRightYAmountSlider.label: Right Eye:   Y

EyesOpenRatioDecimalSlider.help: Changes the opening of the eyes.
EyesOpenRatioDecimalSlider.label: Eyes Close <--> Open Ratio

FaceAdjEnableToggle.help: This is an experimental feature to perform direct adjustments to the face landmarks found by the detector. There is also an option to adjust the scale of the swapped face.
FaceAdjEnableToggle.label: Face Adjustments

FaceBlurParserSlider.help: Blend the value for Face Parser
FaceBlurParserSlider.label: Face Blur

FaceEditorCropScaleDecimalSlider.help: Changes source crop scale. Increase the value to capture the face more distantly. 2.2 scale factor for cropping driving video.
FaceEditorCropScaleDecimalSlider.label: Crop Scale

FaceEditorTypeSelection.help: Select the target type to be edited in Face Editor.
FaceEditorTypeSelection.label: Face Editor Type

FaceEditorVYRatioDecimalSlider.help: Changes the vy ratio for crop scale. Increase the value to capture the face more distantly. -0.1 factor for cropping driving video.
FaceEditorVYRatioDecimalSlider.label: VY Ratio

FaceExpressionAnimationRegionSelection.help: The facial region involved in the restoration process.
FaceExpressionAnimationRegionSelection.label: Animation Region

FaceExpressionCropScaleDecimalSlider.help: Changes swap crop scale. Increase the value to capture the face more distantly.
FaceExpressionCropScaleDecimalSlider.label: Crop Scale

FaceExpressionEnableToggle.help: Enabled the use of the LivePortrait face expression model to restore facial expressions after swapping.
FaceExpressionEnableToggle.label: Enable Face Expression Restorer

FaceExpressionFriendlyFactorDecimalSlide.help: Control the expression similarity between the driving face and the swapped face.
FaceExpressionFriendlyFactorDecimalSlide.label: Expression Friendly Factor

FaceExpressionNormalizeLipsEnableToggle.help: Normalize the lips during the facial restoration process.
FaceExpressionNormalizeLipsEnableToggle.label: Normalize Lips

FaceExpressionRetargetingEyesEnableToggl.help: Adjusting or redirecting the gaze or movement of the eyes during the facial restoration process. It overrides the Animation Region settings, meaning that the Animation Region will be ignored.
FaceExpressionRetargetingEyesEnableToggl.label: Retargeting Eyes

FaceExpressionRetargetingLipsEnableToggl.help: Adjusting or modifying the position, shape, or movement of the lips during the facial restoration process. It overrides the Animation Region settings, meaning that the Animation Region will be ignored.
FaceExpressionRetargetingLipsEnableToggl.label: Retargeting Lips

FaceExpressionVYRatioDecimalSlider.help: Changes the vy ratio for crop scale. Increase the value to capture the face more distantly.
FaceExpressionVYRatioDecimalSlider.label: VY Ratio

FaceFidelityWeight2DecimalSlider.help: Adjust the fidelity weight to control how closely the restoration preserves the original face details.
FaceFidelityWeight2DecimalSlider.label: Fidelity Weight

FaceFidelityWeightDecimalSlider.help: Adjust the fidelity weight to control how closely the restoration preserves the original face details.
FaceFidelityWeightDecimalSlider.label: Fidelity Weight

FaceLikenessEnableToggle.help: This is a feature to perform direct adjustments to likeness of faces.
FaceLikenessEnableToggle.label: Face Likeness

FaceLikenessFactorDecimalSlider.help: Determines the factor of likeness between the source and assigned faces.
FaceLikenessFactorDecimalSlider.label: Amount

FaceMakeupBlendAmountDecimalSlider.help: Blend the value: 0.00 represents the original color, 1.00 represents the full target color.
FaceMakeupBlendAmountDecimalSlider.label: Blend Amount

FaceMakeupEnableToggle.help: Enable face makeup. Except for hair, eyebrows, eyes and lips.
FaceMakeupEnableToggle.label: Face Makeup

FaceParserEnableToggle.help: Allow the unprocessed background from the orginal image to show in the final swap.
FaceParserEnableToggle.label: Face Parser Mask

FaceParserHairMakeupBlendAmountDecimalSl.help: Blend the value: 0.0 represents the original color, 1.0 represents the full target color.
FaceParserHairMakeupBlendAmountDecimalSl.label: Blend Amount

FaceParserLipsMakeupBlendAmountDecimalSl.help: Blend the value: 0.0 represents the original color, 1.0 represents the full target color.
FaceParserLipsMakeupBlendAmountDecimalSl.label: Blend Amount

FaceParserSlider.help: Adjust the size of the Mask. Mast the entire face.
FaceParserSlider.label: Face

FaceRestorerBlend2Slider.help: Control the blend ratio between the restored face and the swapped face.
FaceRestorerBlend2Slider.label: Blend

FaceRestorerBlendSlider.help: Control the blend ratio between the restored face and the swapped face.
FaceRestorerBlendSlider.label: Blend

FaceRestorerDetType2Selection.help: Select the alignment method for restoring the face to its original or blended position.
FaceRestorerDetType2Selection.label: Alignment

FaceRestorerDetTypeSelection.help: Select the alignment method for restoring the face to its original or blended position.
FaceRestorerDetTypeSelection.label: Alignment

FaceRestorerEnable2Toggle.help: Enable the use of a face restoration model to improve the quality of the face after swapping.
FaceRestorerEnable2Toggle.label: Enable Face Restorer 2

FaceRestorerEnableToggle.help: Enable the use of a face restoration model to improve the quality of the face after swapping.
FaceRestorerEnableToggle.label: Enable Face Restorer

FaceRestorerType2Selection.help: Select the model type for face restoration.
FaceRestorerType2Selection.label: Restorer Type

FaceRestorerTypeSelection.help: Select the model type for face restoration.
FaceRestorerTypeSelection.label: Restorer Type

FaceScaleAmountSlider.help: Grows and shrinks the entire face.
FaceScaleAmountSlider.label: Face Scale Amount

FinalBlendAdjEnableToggle.help: Blend at the end of pipeline.
FinalBlendAdjEnableToggle.label: Final Blend

FrameEnhancerBlendSlider.help: Blends the enhanced results back into the original frame.
FrameEnhancerBlendSlider.label: Blend

FrameEnhancerEnableToggle.help: Enable frame enhancement for video inputs to improve visual quality.
FrameEnhancerEnableToggle.label: Enable Frame Enhancer

FrameEnhancerTypeSelection.help: Select the type of frame enhancement to apply, based on the content and resolution requirements.
FrameEnhancerTypeSelection.label: Frame Enhancer Type

HairMakeupBlendAmountDecimalSlider.help: Blend the value: 0.00 represents the original color, 1.00 represents the full target color.
HairMakeupBlendAmountDecimalSlider.label: Blend Amount

HairParserSlider.help: Adjust the size of the Mask. Mast the hair.
HairParserSlider.label: Hair

HeadPitchSlider.help: Changes the opening of the lips.
HeadPitchSlider.label: Head Pitch

InputFacesFolderRecursiveToggle.help: Include all files from Subfolders when choosing Input Faces Folder
InputFacesFolderRecursiveToggle.label: Input Faces Include Subfolders

KpsScaleSlider.help: Grows and shrinks the detection point distances.
KpsScaleSlider.label: Keypoints Scale

KpsXSlider.help: Shifts the detection points left and right.
KpsXSlider.label: Keypoints X-Axis

KpsYSlider.help: Shifts the detection points up and down.
KpsYSlider.label: Keypoints Y-Axis

LandmarkDetectModelSelection.help: Select the landmark detection model, where different models detect varying numbers of facial landmarks.
LandmarkDetectModelSelection.label: Landmark Detect Model

LandmarkDetectScoreSlider.help: Set the confidence score threshold for facial landmark detection.
LandmarkDetectScoreSlider.label: Landmark Detect Score

LandmarkDetectToggle.help: Enable or disable facial landmark detection, which is used to refine face alignment.
LandmarkDetectToggle.label: Enable Landmark Detection

LandmarksPositionAdjEnableToggle.help: This is an experimental feature to perform direct adjustments to the position of face landmarks found by the detector.
LandmarksPositionAdjEnableToggle.label: 5 - Keypoints Adjustments

LeftEyeParserSlider.help: Adjust the size of the Mask. Mast the left eye.
LeftEyeParserSlider.label: Left Eye

LeftEyebrowParserSlider.help: Adjust the size of the Mask. Mast the left eyebrow.
LeftEyebrowParserSlider.label: Left Eyebrow

LipsCloseOpenSlider.help: Changes the closing or opening of the lips.
LipsCloseOpenSlider.label: Lips Close <--> Open Value

LipsMakeupBlendAmountDecimalSlider.help: Blend the value: 0.0 represents the original color, 1.0 represents the full target color.
LipsMakeupBlendAmountDecimalSlider.label: Blend Amount

LipsOpenRatioDecimalSlider.help: Changes the opening of the lips.
LipsOpenRatioDecimalSlider.label: Lips Close <--> Open Ratio

LowerLipParserSlider.help: Adjust the size of the Mask. Mast the lower lip.
LowerLipParserSlider.label: Lower Lip

ManualRotationAngleSlider.help: Set this to the angle of the input face angle to help with laying down/upside down/etc. Angles are read clockwise.
ManualRotationAngleSlider.label: Rotation Angle

ManualRotationEnableToggle.help: Rotate the face detector to better detect faces at different angles.
ManualRotationEnableToggle.label: Manual Rotation

MaxDFMModelsSlider.help: Set the maximum number of DFM Models to keep in memory at a time. Set this based on your GPU's VRAM
MaxDFMModelsSlider.label: Maximum DFM Models to use

MaxFacesToDetectSlider.help: Set the maximum number of faces to detect in a frame
MaxFacesToDetectSlider.label: Max No of Faces to Detect

MouthLeftXAmountSlider.help: Shifts the mouth left detection point left and right.
MouthLeftXAmountSlider.label: Left Mouth:   X

MouthLeftYAmountSlider.help: Shifts the mouth left detection point up and down.
MouthLeftYAmountSlider.label: Left Mouth:   Y

MouthParserSlider.help: Adjust the size of the Mask. Mast the inside of the mouth, including the tongue.
MouthParserSlider.label: Mouth

MouthRightXAmountSlider.help: Shifts the mouth Right detection point left and right.
MouthRightXAmountSlider.label: Right Mouth:   X

MouthRightYAmountSlider.help: Shifts the mouth Right detection point up and down.
MouthRightYAmountSlider.label: Right Mouth:   Y

NeckParserSlider.help: Adjust the size of the Mask. Mast the neck.
NeckParserSlider.label: Neck

NoseParserSlider.help: Adjust the size of the Mask. Mast the nose.
NoseParserSlider.label: Nose

NoseXAmountSlider.help: Shifts the nose detection point left and right.
NoseXAmountSlider.label: Nose:   X

NoseYAmountSlider.help: Shifts the nose detection point up and down.
NoseYAmountSlider.label: Nose:   Y

OccluderEnableToggle.help: Allow objects occluding the face to show up in the swapped image.
OccluderEnableToggle.label: Occlusion Mask

OccluderSizeSlider.help: Grows or shrinks the occluded region
OccluderSizeSlider.label: Size

OccluderXSegBlurSlider.help: Blend value for Occluder and XSeg.
OccluderXSegBlurSlider.label: Occluder/DFL XSeg Blur

OverallMaskBlendAmountSlider.help: Combined masks blending distance. It is not applied to the border masks.
OverallMaskBlendAmountSlider.label: Overall Mask Blend Amount

ProvidersPrioritySelection.help: Select the theme to be used
ProvidersPrioritySelection.label: Providers Priority

RecognitionModelSelection.help: Choose the ArcFace model to be used for comparing the similarity of faces.
RecognitionModelSelection.label: Recognition Model

RestoreEyesBlendAmountSlider.help: Increase this to show more of the swapped eyes. Decrease it to show more of the original eyes.
RestoreEyesBlendAmountSlider.label: Eyes Blend Amount

RestoreEyesEnableToggle.help: Restore eyes from the original face.
RestoreEyesEnableToggle.label: Restore Eyes

RestoreEyesFeatherBlendSlider.help: Adjust the blending of eyes border. Increase this to show more of the original eyes. Decrease this to show more of the swapped eyes.
RestoreEyesFeatherBlendSlider.label: Eyes Feather Blend

RestoreEyesMouthBlurSlider.help: Adjust the blur of mask border.
RestoreEyesMouthBlurSlider.label: Eyes/Mouth Blur

RestoreEyesSizeFactorDecimalSlider.help: Reduce this when swapping faces zoomed out of the frame.
RestoreEyesSizeFactorDecimalSlider.label: Eyes Size Factor

RestoreMouthBlendAmountSlider.help: Increase this to show more of the swapped Mouth. Decrease it to show more of the original Mouth.
RestoreMouthBlendAmountSlider.label: Mouth Blend Amount

RestoreMouthEnableToggle.help: Restore mouth from the original face.
RestoreMouthEnableToggle.label: Restore Mouth

RestoreMouthFeatherBlendSlider.help: Adjust the border of Mouth blending. Increase this to show more of the original Mouth. Decrease this to show more of the swapped Mouth.
RestoreMouthFeatherBlendSlider.label: Mouth Feather Blend

RestoreMouthSizeFactorSlider.help: Increase this when swapping faces zoomed out of the frame.
RestoreMouthSizeFactorSlider.label: Mouth Size Factor

RestoreXEyesOffsetSlider.help: Moves the Eyes Mask on the X Axis.
RestoreXEyesOffsetSlider.label: X Eyes Offset

RestoreXEyesRadiusFactorDecimalSlider.help: These parameters determine the shape of the mask. If both are equal to 1.0, the mask will be circular. If either one is greater or less than 1.0, the mask will become oval, stretching or shrinking along the corresponding direction.
RestoreXEyesRadiusFactorDecimalSlider.label: X Eyes Radius Factor

RestoreXMouthOffsetSlider.help: Moves the Mouth Mask on the X Axis.
RestoreXMouthOffsetSlider.label: X Mouth Offset

RestoreXMouthRadiusFactorDecimalSlider.help: These parameters determine the shape of the mask. If both are equal to 1.0, the mask will be circular. If either one is greater or less than 1.0, the mask will become oval, stretching or shrinking along the corresponding direction.
RestoreXMouthRadiusFactorDecimalSlider.label: X Mouth Radius Factor

RestoreYEyesOffsetSlider.help: Moves the Eyes Mask on the Y Axis.
RestoreYEyesOffsetSlider.label: Y Eyes Offset

RestoreYEyesRadiusFactorDecimalSlider.help: These parameters determine the shape of the mask. If both are equal to 1.0, the mask will be circular. If either one is greater or less than 1.0, the mask will become oval, stretching or shrinking along the corresponding direction.
RestoreYEyesRadiusFactorDecimalSlider.label: Y Eyes Radius Factor

RestoreYMouthOffsetSlider.help: Moves the Mouth Mask on the Y Axis.
RestoreYMouthOffsetSlider.label: Y Mouth Offset

RestoreYMouthRadiusFactorDecimalSlider.help: These parameters determine the shape of the mask. If both are equal to 1.0, the mask will be circular. If either one is greater or less than 1.0, the mask will become oval, stretching or shrinking along the corresponding direction.
RestoreYMouthRadiusFactorDecimalSlider.label: Y Mouth Radius Factor

RightEyeParserSlider.help: Adjust the size of the Mask. Mast the right eye.
RightEyeParserSlider.label: Right Eye

RightEyebrowParserSlider.help: Adjust the size of the Mask. Mast the right eyebrow.
RightEyebrowParserSlider.label: Right Eyebrow

ShowAllDetectedFacesBBoxToggle.help: Draw bounding boxes to all detected faces in the frame
ShowAllDetectedFacesBBoxToggle.label: Show Bounding Boxes

SimilarityThresholdSlider.help: Set the similarity threshold to control how similar the detected face should be to the reference (target) face.
SimilarityThresholdSlider.label: Similarity Threshold

SimilarityTypeSelection.help: Choose the type of similarity calculation for face detection and matching during the face swapping process.
SimilarityTypeSelection.label: Swapping Similarity Type

StrengthAmountSlider.help: Increase up to 5x additional swaps (500%). 200% is generally a good result. Set to 0 to turn off swapping but allow the rest of the pipeline to apply to the original image.
StrengthAmountSlider.label: Amount

StrengthEnableToggle.help: Apply additional swapping iterations to increase the strength of the result, which may increase likeness.
StrengthEnableToggle.label: Strength

SwapModelSelection.help: Choose which swapper model to use for face swapping.
SwapModelSelection.label: Swapper Model

SwapperResSelection.help: Select the resolution for the swapped face in pixels. Higher values offer better quality but are slower to process.
SwapperResSelection.label: Swapper Resolution

TargetMediaFolderRecursiveToggle.help: Include all files from Subfolders when choosing Target Media Folder
TargetMediaFolderRecursiveToggle.label: Target Media Include Subfolders

ThemeSelection.help: Select the providers priority to be used with the system.
ThemeSelection.label: Theme

UpperLipParserSlider.help: Adjust the size of the Mask. Mast the upper lip.
UpperLipParserSlider.label: Upper Lip

VideoPlaybackCustomFpsSlider.help: Set the maximum FPS of the video when playing
VideoPlaybackCustomFpsSlider.label: Video Playback FPS

VideoPlaybackCustomFpsToggle.help: Manually set the FPS to be used when playing the video
VideoPlaybackCustomFpsToggle.label: Set Custom Video Playback FPS

WebCamMaxFPSSelection.help: Set the maximum frames per second (FPS) for webcam input.
WebCamMaxFPSSelection.label: Webcam FPS

WebcamBackendSelection.help: Choose the backend for accessing webcam input.
WebcamBackendSelection.label: Webcam Backend

WebcamEnableToggle.help: Enable the use of the webcam as the input source for face swapping.
WebcamEnableToggle.label: Enable Webcam

WebcamMaxNoSelection.help: Select the maximum number of webcam streams to allow for face swapping.
WebcamMaxNoSelection.label: Webcam Max No

WebcamMaxResSelection.help: Select the maximum resolution for webcam input.
WebcamMaxResSelection.label: Webcam Resolution

nThreadsSlider.help: Set number of execution threads while playing and recording. Depends strongly on GPU VRAM.
nThreadsSlider.label: Number of Threads
